function.name: memory_store
function.description: Remember a durable fact for the long term (e.g. a user preference, identity detail, or standing commitment). Use this only for information worth recalling in future conversations, not transient task details.

content.description: The fact to remember, written concisely in the third person.

tags.description: Short topic labels to file this memory under (e.g. "preference", "identity"). You recall by these labels later.

keywords.description: Optional extra search terms that need not appear in the content.
